name: Inline Image Headline
summary: A large statement whose words light up with scroll progress, with small illustrations embedded inside the running text that fade up in a stagger, followed by a looping row of icon pills.
useWhen: A landing page needs a big manifesto or intro sentence with icons woven into the text
Words should read from muted to full contrast as the visitor scrolls
A row of category chips should drift sideways under a headline
avoidWhen: The headline is short and static; a plain heading is enough
Text must be fully visible without scrolling; the reveal dims unread words
